description: Nginx can deliver static website files. Learn request paths, configuration blocks, content types, caching and error pages by reading small examples for a local practice setup. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
learningObjectives: Practise use a helpful error page
Practise read access and error logs

seo.description: Learn Nginx with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
